Joint: Base cross member to base side rail
Side hoop rear foot to base side rail
How: Round tube cut square, standing on the top face of the rail, fillet all round

Joint: Side hoop front foot to base side rail
How: Round tube standing on the top face of the rail, foot sawn 22.7 degrees off square so the pillar leans back, fillet all round

Joint: Axle post to base side rail
Axle post to the roof run of the side hoop
How: Tee onto round tube: post top cut 10.2 degrees off square and notched (coped) to the 25.4 round tube, fillet all round

Joint: Top cross tube to the roof run of the side hoop
How: Tee onto round tube: end notched (coped) to the 25.4 round tube, fillet all round

Joint: Nose hoop foot to base side rail
How: Round tube cut square, standing on the top face of the rail, fillet all round

Joint: Handle bar arm to the rear leg of the side hoop and to the axle post
How: Crossing lap: the round arm lies against the outside of the hoop leg (round on round) and of the axle post (round on flat). Fillet round each contact. A small weld; the shop may add a through bolt
